items.title: Why gold and silver prices have fallen to their lowest in over a year
items.summary: Gold and silver prices have slumped to their lowest levels in more than a year as a strong US dollar, high bond yields and bets on another US interest rate hike sap demand. The gold price is on track for its biggest annual fall since 2015.
